text: Lina (PM): Quick snag from usability testing: the help chip in the Models list reads 'Tag' and links to docs. Testers expected 'Version' and couldn't find pin instructions quickly. Sam (Design): We used 'Tag' to save space in the row. I'm fine switching the visible label to 'Version' and keeping a compact inline link 'How to pin' that goes straight to the pinning section. Priya (Docs): Docs canonical term is 'model version'. I can add an explicit anchor #pinning-flow and a short note: 'Console label may appear as "Tag" in older UI'. Also will add alias so legacy links still work. Omar (Eng): Implementation notes: changing label text is trivial. Fragments don't hit the server, so adding the tag anchor in the HTML is the right fix. Also we'll leave the analytics event name model_tag_click to avoid breaking dashboards, but map it to the new label in telemetry. Sam (Design): Accessibility: inline link should read 'How to pin a model version' for screen readers. Tooltip (if we add one) must be keyboard-focusable and have aria-describedby. Priya (Docs): I'll update the docs, add the alias anchor, and include a glossary line. ETA: PR today. Omar (Eng): I'll open a small UI change branch and include aria-label. I'll also add a tiny e2e that clicks the inline link and asserts URL fragment is #pinning-flow and focus lands on the H2. HelpBot: checklist: docs-pr: pending, ui-branch: created, qa-ticket: QA-2042. Lina (PM): Good. Please keep the visible copy and docs anchor consistent and add the one-line cross-link to the glossary so support can point people there. Reconvene after PRs. Sam (Design): Uploaded updated microcopy to Figma: two variants (short vs explicit). Marked preferred for a11y. Priya (Docs): Will ping when PR merges. Omar (Eng): Landing the UI change after docs merge. No blockers.
